	<h1>OSP 2019 <a name='Nirrum's Encyclopedia of Varomar:Plot Notes:OSP 2019'></a></h1>
	</div>

	<div class='content'>
	<p>
Created Thursday 21 March 2019<br>
Fargim has added concordance with pelor for destroying an enemy god altar<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Kohipinrolo</b> <b>Milat (Wizard 9 Divination)(INFJ) had a night with Trizane</b>
</div>
</p>

<br>
<br>

<p>
ONE SHOT
</p>

<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>

<p>
Aumanas Xyrqen - Mayor of Ilfea
</p>

<p>
An acre provides 1500 pounds of tea leaves.<br>
1500 pounds of leaves create 375 pounds of tea.<br>
A pound of tea will make 181 cups of tea.<br>
&gt;<br>
An acre of tea will produce 67875 cups of tea.<br>
An acre requires 2 workers to maintain and manage.<br>
I say we purchase 10 acres of land for tea and hire 20 people, just to test how things work out<br>
And we get a druid to work on the fields for a few days and expediate the grows of plants and make them produce
</p>

<br>
<br>
<br>

<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Necklace of Adaption
</div>
</p>

<p>

Vicious warhammer
</div>
</p>

<p>
A horse bone armor stand<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
By using an action to say the command word *Fricasee*, this Armor stand acts as if used as ammunition for the catapult spell cast at 7th level. It has 1 charge which it regains daily at dawn.
</div>
</p>

an almond wood ring<br>

As a driftglobe

</div>
</p>

<p>
A steel buckler<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
of expression<br>
Curse: Requires food and alcohol once a month. If it is not fed, it no longer grants any bonuses and instead grants a -2 to AC for each month that passes without being fed.
</div>
</p>

<p>
An iron spear<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Weapon of the Flower of Battle</b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
A dagger, Longsword, Spear, Halberd, Glaive, or lance  (rare), Requires attunement
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 90pt'>
This weapon grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls. You do not need a free hand to grapple or disarm while Using this weapon.
</div>
</p>

<p>
A sphalerite weapon rack<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Weapon placed on this rack for at least 8 hours do an additional 1d4 force damage the next time they hit with an attack within the next day
</div>
A tetrahedrite ring<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Animal influence
</div>
A giant cave swallow leather quiver,<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Quiver of Ehlonna
</div>
A steel shield<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Animated shield
</div>
A gemstone, perfect cat's eye.<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Crystal ball of mind reading
</div>
A bone crossbow<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
As a Charity Weapon
</div>
and a magical bone chest<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
As a Portable hole
</div>
</p>
